p: holy crown: So called, because this superscription, "holiness to the Lord" was graven in it.
tabernacle and all that was therein: That is, the holiest of holies, the sanctuary and the court.
altar round about with his finger: Of the burnt offering.
it: To offer for the sins of the people.
hide: In other burnt offerings, which are not of consecration, or offering for himself, the priest has the skin, Le 7:8.
slew it: Moses did this because the priests were not yet established in their office.
tabernacle of the congregation: At the door of the court.
hand of Moses: By commission given to Moses.
